title: extension-compat manifest (v1)
description: Checked-in compatibility manifest mapping known third-party extensions (npm pi-package keyword and 0.85 gallery snapshot) to 0.85-compatible version constraints. Backwards-compatibility policy: additive-only within v1 (new optional properties may be added to root or PackageCompatEntry without a version bump); any breaking change (removing required fields, narrowing types/patterns, or changing resolution semantics) requires bumping the top-level version field to 2. Companion examples and resolution traces live in specs/contracts/json-schema/extension-compat-manifest.examples.md.
$comment: Traceability — Realises: REQ-EXT (R-EXT-001, R-EXT-005, R-EXT-006, R-EXT-007). Depends on: ADR-0003. References: specs/contracts/json-schema/extension-compat-manifest.examples.md, IMPL-EXTENSIONS. Keying & incompatibility policy: npm-published extensions are keyed by canonical npm package name and git-only gallery extensions are keyed by 'git:<host>/<owner>/<repo>' matching packages/coding-agent/src/core/package-manager.ts:1691-1704; deprecated or abandoned extensions with no 0.85-compatible release use compatibleRange '<0.0.0' with notes explaining the incompatibility so installs fail with E_EXT_NO_COMPATIBLE_VERSION and surface the note.

version.description: Manifest contract major version. Must be 1 for all v1 manifests; breaking schema changes increment this integer.

baselineVersion.description: Host compatibility baseline version that entries in this manifest were verified against.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when this manifest snapshot was last updated.

packages.description: Dictionary mapping canonical npm package names (e.g. '@scope/pkg' or 'pkg') or normalized git keys ('git:github.com/owner/repo') to their 0.85 compatibility constraint entry.

name.description: Canonical npm registry package name (or 'git:<host>/<owner>/<repo>' identifier for git-only packages). Must match the enclosing key in 'packages'.

compatibleRange.description: Valid node-semver range (parsed via semver.validRange) or exact semver version designating all releases of this package compatible with the 0.85 host API. Use '<0.0.0' for deprecated/incompatible packages that have no 0.85-compatible release.

recommendedVersion.description: Optional exact semver version known to satisfy compatibleRange, used as a reference pin in diagnostics and tests.

gitUrl.description: Optional source-control repository URL alternative for the package. When present, gitRef is required.

gitRef.description: Pinned git tag or full 40-character commit SHA corresponding to the 0.85-compatible revision when installed via gitUrl.

lastReviewed.description: ISO-8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the entry was last audited against the 0.85 extension API.

notes.description: Optional human-readable audit notes explaining version upper bounds or breaking changes in newer upstream versions.
examples: Versions >=2.0.0 require upstream 0.86 session hooks; pin to <=1.4.2.
